items.source: ScriptCompilationException - if the evaluator failed to read, compile or evaluate the script
items.translation: ScriptCompilationException - 如果评估器无法读取、编译或评估脚本

items.source: Aside from language-specific implementations, Spring also ships a version based on the standard javax.script package (JSR-223): StandardScriptEvaluator.
items.translation: 除了特定语言的实现之外，Spring 还提供了一个基于标准 `javax.script` 包（JSR-223）的版本：StandardScriptEvaluator。

items.source: Evaluate the given script with the given arguments.
items.translation: 评估给定脚本及其参数。

items.source: arguments - the key-value pairs to expose to the script, typically as script variables (may be null or empty)
items.translation: arguments - 要暴露给脚本的键值对，通常作为脚本变量（可能为 null 或为空）

items.source: script - the ScriptSource for the script to evaluate
the return value of the script, if any
